title: 60-FPS interaction profiling harness with one verified bottleneck fix
outcome: A repeatable, checked-in measurement harness produces real frame-time numbers for common canvas interactions (move, resize, pan, zoom, and a many-layer document with layer effects), identifies the actual bottleneck from data, and delivers at most one minimal, visually-identical compositor fix for a proven bottleneck (candidate: unbounded shadow saveLayer region) — or documents with measurements that no fix is justified yet.
before: GOVERNOR.md Performance Budgets require 60 FPS for common interactions, and docs/reviews/sprint-critic-01.md flags (P2) that shadow saveLayer is unbounded, allocating up to a full-page offscreen plus blur per shadowed layer per composite. No repeatable frame-time harness exists in the repository; no baseline numbers exist. Builder must record before-numbers first.
after: scripts/perf contains a harness that boots the real editor and reports per-operation frame times; a baseline report is committed; the identified fix (if any) is pixel-identical on fixed captures and improves measured frame time on the targeted operation without regressing others.
acceptance: Harness runs headlessly from a clean checkout and emits frame-time numbers for at least: drag move, resize, pan, zoom, and a 30-layer document with drop shadows.
Baseline numbers recorded before any production change and committed in the report.

Any compositor change is proven pixel-identical on before/after captures of a representative document (canvas screenshot diff) and improves the targeted operation's measured frame time or documents why not.
No visual change to any rendered output; existing suites stay green.
npx tsc --noEmit and npm run build pass.
evidence: Before/after numbers for the targeted operation

builder.notes: Harness in scripts/perf (run.mjs 13 scenarios: idle + move/resize/pan/zoom on starter, plain30, shadow30; capture.mjs pixel proof). Baseline committed at f973318 BEFORE any production change. Single compositor fix: withDropShadow saveLayer bounded to layerBounds + spread (3σ shadow blur + |offset| + nested glow/stroke dilation + vector stroke half-width + 2px AA epsilon; null-bounds fallback preserves old behaviour). Pixel-identical: shadow30 page composite raw-RGBA sha-256 equal before/after (0fa979a3fc68810c0e8b8801690bf2281220d171023d9aa54546ba0622b4b44c, 2480x3508). Measured: idle/shadow30 115482.4ms -> 908.9ms median (127x); shadow gesture drawMs p95 95562-131008ms -> 984-1203ms; plain/starter scenarios unchanged within run noise. Gates: npx tsc --noEmit clean; npm run test:unit 316/316; npm run build exit 0; tests/effects.spec.mjs 15/15 (leaf+group shadow/glow/stroke/gradient render checks).

verifier.notes: Independent re-run of harness + pixel-diff required.

critic.notes: Engine-only; pixel-identical requirement replaces aesthetic review.
